name: New York City street kit
style_profile: Hopan PS1, low-poly, muted masonry and yellow cabs, night billboard accents

requirements.text: Distinct taxi, sedan, city bus and delivery truck silhouettes, +X forward.
Four named wheel pivots on each vehicle and bounded traffic collision contract.
Perimeter skyline with stepped silhouette, water towers, fire escapes and original billboards.

stages.title: Brief and style
criteria: Declare game scale, forward axis, recognizable vehicle assemblies and camera constraints.

stages.title: Primary proportions
criteria: Four distinct silhouettes with 2.6/4.4/3.5-unit bodies; front, side and three-quarter rendered evidence.

stages.title: Secondary assemblies
criteria: Vehicle cabins, side glazing, door frames, named wheel pivots; skyline windows and water towers.

stages.title: Mechanical wheel hierarchy
criteria: Four Wheel_* pivots per vehicle, wheels rotate about local Z; collision supplied by traffic runtime.

stages.title: Distinguishing details
criteria: Taxi checker stripe and roof sign, bus route display, truck roll-up slats, mirrors and fire escapes.

stages.title: Materials and optimization
criteria: Restrained PS1 low-poly palette, luminous lamps and merged stationary bodies; no repeated body meshes per primitive.

stages.title: Independent visual critique
criteria: Inspect front, side, three-quarter and gameplay views. Record defects and rework.

stages.title: Godot integration
criteria: Native procedural source is runtime export. Instantiate all models without engine errors; test in traffic.

stages.title: Animation handoff
criteria: Wheel names and +X forward documented. Traffic runtime owns speed, orientation and wheel rotation.
